title: LeakBench: A Labelled Benchmark for Data-Leakage Detection in ML Task Specifications
description: An expert-authored, labelled benchmark for detecting data leakage in machine-learning task specifications, with a deterministic grader, reproducible non-LLM baselines, a leaderboard, an LLM-judge adapter interface, and contamination controls (canary string + near-duplicate check). Public/synthetic content only; no private or employer data.
